title: Davis's papers for Marc Millis's propulsion physics program

tellings.quote: to do with UFOs. has to do with Mark propulsion physics program. I'm just contributing my knowledge.

plain: A scientist named Eric W. Davis, who appears on the show as a Pentagon scientist, says that between about 1990 and 2009 he wrote papers for a propulsion physics program at NASA run by a man named Marc Millis, a program studying new ways to move spacecraft. Davis, who says he took part himself, tells Michels the work had nothing to do with UFOs: "I'm just contributing my knowledge."
